notes: Game Bot V0.10: Chat understands typos and slightly-off wording — confident matches are applied silently, and if it's unsure it asks 'Did you mean X? (yes runs it)'. 'Add more enemies' / 'more enemies' now increases the enemy count in games that already have enemies (for example a sci-fi FPS) and asks before rebuilding, instead of looking for an empty folder or offering packs. Packs are offered only when the game has no enemy system.
